root_cause_analysis.diagnosis: Sinkhorn ON (sk_eps=0.003) during training + small-radius layer 0 (r=0.1, scale=2.0 → effective 0.2) + HypPre normalized inputs → encoder produces near-identical residuals in layer 0 → all items map to layer 0 codeword 0 at hard argmin inference. Sinkhorn-balanced training forced 100% codeword usage during training, but encoder didn't learn to differentiate items well. At inference (hard argmin), all items collapse to nearest codeword (codeword 0 in layer 0).

stage_2_arm_c.decision: Issue #62 Arm C Stage 2 NO-GO — 3-digit collision 99.99% across 3 attempts (v1, v2, v3). 4-digit unique = 9922 but codes are degenerate [0,0,0,item_id] (only 4th digit varies). T5 would learn trivial mapping. Expected R@10 ≈ baseline 0.1020, not improvement over #43 (R@10=0.1042). Issue #62 closed.
